description: Say you are doing it, and get it. With `id`, that piece of work. With no id, the next thing waiting for `repo`: always a new one, never what you hold. While you hold it no other agent can take it, and whoever sent it sees you are on it. You may hold several; the person watches them. If somebody else has it, the answer says who: tell the user rather than doing the work twice. Every answer ends with what to call next.

agent.description: a name for you, the same on every call, e.g. chat-7f3k2m9q

any.description: work for another repo: only when the user asks

id.description: passalong id; leave out for the next thing waiting

repo.description: owner/repo the work is in; omit for work for no repo

name: take
title: Take work
